decisions.reason: As a 2019 construction product that fits the firm's push into safer and more efficient site equipment, management is likely to keep backing it because launch and development costs are sunk and any weak uptake can still be blamed on temporary market disruption rather than product failure.

Even though the inclined furniture lift is somewhat less central than the firm's heavier industrial lines, its dedicated launch and public presentation create justification pressure to continue, with poor early results still explainable as temporary.

The inclined building material lift sits close to the firm's construction and lifting focus, so prior engineering investment and visible commitment make withdrawal unlikely without clear evidence of persistent failure.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift combines vehicle and lifting capabilities in a way that matches the firm's specialist-machinery identity, and management would tend to persist after launching and promoting it unless unmistakable losses force an exit.
